description.value: Indian Burger Joint is a 100% vegetarian and vegan fast-casual chain founded in 2023 by Navneet Bhadu, serving Indian-spiced fusion burgers, grilled sandwiches, naan-wiches, tacos, and Indian street food across five BC locations. The White Rock outpost on Marine Drive offers dine-in, takeout, and delivery, with a menu rooted in traditional Indian flavors rather than meat imitation. Culturally immersive décor, Indian-themed murals, and a broad beverage selection including masala chai, falooda, and Indian refreshers make it a distinctive stop for cyclists seeking a fully plant-based meal.

address.value: 15527 Marine Dr, White Rock, BC V4B 1C7

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a real, open fast-casual restaurant at 15527 Marine Dr, White Rock, with dine-in, takeout, and delivery listed. The business is explicitly 100% vegetarian and vegan per both OSM tags (diet:vegan=yes, diet:vegetarian=yes) and extensive website content.
